description:
Resolve the suggested toolset and recommended tier for a named posture. Returns tool ids from the live manifest, the directive keys the host must inject on turns that exercise file-write or shell tooling, and advisory suggestedPromptBlocks (PROMPTS registry keys the host may opt into via directive injection). Throws UnknownPosture for unrecognised posture names.

Free: does not call an AI provider.
name: getPostureDefaults
